# Known Claude Code built-in tool names, one per line (union across the CLI
# versions Watchtower supports; a legacy name stays listed). Pinned so the
# offline guard TestChatBuiltins_* runs in CI without a CLI. Seeded by hand
# for Claude Code 2.1.288 from the CLI's tool registry strings and the
# previous deny list. `scripts/check-claude-builtins.sh` compares the
# installed CLI's built-in set against this file; with --update it adds the
# names the CLI has that are missing here, keeping the list sorted.
#
# WaitForMcpServers is registered only when MCP servers are mounted (every
# chat run mounts watchtower); --tools already hides it from chats, and the
# deny list carries it too as defence in depth: no chat prompt relies on the
# model waiting for a server.
